name: Mystery Man
source:
Race: Male human

He is as mysterious as his name suggests. He claims to be a traveler who enjoys places abundant of dark aura. In OASE, Mystery Man can be found lurking on Dude Island. 

First appeared in Zeiva's early game series - Genetic Glow.
